spec_text_or_path: Peacemaker Gunslinger: irreducible 3-stance rotation (Pistol: +16% Attack Speed / Shotgun: +10% Crit Rate +24% Damage / Rifle: +28% Damage); Pacifist node unifies buffs active in any stance but the rotation THROUGH all three stances is the identity — no single dominant mode; the buff architecture is stance-specific and the kit's value comes from cycling all three; cannot collapse to a single dominant delivery shape without 'not that build' failure
